title: Introducing dots
text: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

title: Towards safety cases for frontier AI training
text: Our early guidelines for safety cases in frontier AI training cover technical safeguards, operational practices, and investigating misalignment incidents

title: How we will do better for Australia
text: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
text: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.

title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
text: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.

title: Are you a Codex Original?
text: We’re collecting real stories of builders, tinkerers, researchers, and creators who are using Codex to do incredible things. If you want to be a part of the next chapter of the Codex Originals program

title: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex
text: With Codex, GPT-Live-1, and GPT-6 Astra, Proaction builds, operates, and sells modern fleet management faster.

title: Lowe’s answers millions of home improvement questions with OpenAI
text: Lowe’s uses OpenAI models to power Mylow and Mylow Companion, helping customers and associates answer 25M+ questions and move home improvement projects forward.

title: Wayfair boosts catalog accuracy and support speed with OpenAI
text: Wayfair uses OpenAI models to improve ecommerce support and product catalog accuracy, automating ticket triage and enhancing millions of product attributes at scale.

title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
text: Marking two years of OpenAI Academy and bringing AI skills to even more communities.

title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
text: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.

title: How invideo improves color grading 3x with GPT‑6 Astra
text: With GPT‑6 Astra, invideo plans edits with greater precision, improves color correction and grading threefold, and produces 50 custom effects in one day.

title: Sam Altman’s remarks at the United Nations Security Council
text: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discusses AI safety, human control, and international cooperation in remarks to the United Nations Security Council.

title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
text: Using GPT-5.6, Ringg powers multilingual agents across voice, chat, WhatsApp, and web for 90% less cost vs. GPT-4.1.

title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
text: GPT-6 Astra produces more structured, context-aware legal documents, freeing lawyers to focus on strategy.

title: Introducing MentalHealthBench
text: MentalHealthBench is an expert-informed benchmark for evaluating helpful and safe AI responses across realistic mental health conversations.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to Southeast Asia and Taiwan
text: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to Southeast Asia and Taiwan, giving eligible businesses new ways to reach people across more than 60 countries.

title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
text: Learn how Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models to help engineering teams solve bugs, design systems, and ship faster.

title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
text: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
text: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.

title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
text: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.

title: Parallel cut research time and cost in half with GPT‑6 Astra
text: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.

title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
text: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.

title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
text: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.

title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
text: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
text: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.

title: Expanding OpenAI Academy with new learning paths
text: Explore new OpenAI Academy learning paths for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students to build and demonstrate practical AI skills.

title: V7 cuts costs 78% while boosting accuracy with GPT-5.6 Luna
text: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.

title: Introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
text: OpenAI introduces the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a six-pillar roadmap for safer AI experiences that protect and empower young people.

title: How Cooley is accelerating IPO work with ChatGPT
text: Cooley built GO Public with ChatGPT Work to bring intelligence to the IPO process, helping lawyers surface issues earlier and focus judgment where it matters most.

title: Introducing Astra for Law
text: OpenAI for Law brings frontier intelligence for law, custom firm workflows, connected legal data sources, and legal-grade controls for confidential client work.

title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
text: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.

title: Reimagining advertising with AI
text: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
text: GPT-6 Astra helps Hex’s data agents turn answers into interactive visualizations that employees are proud to share.

title: How to connect AI usage to business value
text: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.

title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
text: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
text: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
text: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
text: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
text: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
text: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.

title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
text: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.

title: Now everyone can put data to work
text: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.

title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
text: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials.

title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
text: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support.

title: Introducing the Agents API
text: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.
